# Escherichia coli: Species Guidance

E. coli is usually modeled as a haploid bacterium with a circular chromosome.
Important scenario variables include strain background, plasmids, mobile
elements, operons, repeat/rRNA architecture, homologous recombination, and
horizontal gene transfer. It is excellent for hybrid-assembly truth benchmarks
because a compact, known reference can be modified reproducibly.

For bacterial GWAS, do not reuse diploid human GWAS defaults. Strong clonal
lineage structure, accessory genes, k-mers, and recombination can confound
association. Treat bacterial GWAS as a separate analysis design requiring
lineage-aware covariates and a declared variant representation.

Useful reference: E. coli K-12 MG1655 genome, DOI 10.1126/science.277.5331.1453.
